1, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation, hereby declare under Sub section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act,that the land described below is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

An allotment of Land described as follows depicted in the Advance Tracing No : MAHA/HRS/2023/41 and dated 22.02.2024, prepared by the Surveyor General, situated at the Village of Kulugammana in the Grama Niladhari Division of No.447 Kulugammana in Kulugammana Siyapattuwa Minior Division in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Harispattuwa in the District of Kandy in the Central Province and bouned as follows.
01. Lot ‘A’ - Pansalwatta alias Pansal Aramba - Extent: 0.0072 Hectare North by:Pansalwatta alias Pansal Aramba claimed by Kulugammana Raja Maha Viharaya and Road of the

Provincial Road Development Authority ; East by: Road of the Provincial Road Development Authority and Pansalwatta alias Pansal Aramba claimed by State; South by: Pansalwatta alias Pansal Aramba claimed by State and Pansalwatta alias Pansal Aramba claimed by Kulugammana Raja Maha Viharaya ; West by: Pansalwatta alias Pansal Aramba claimed by Kulugammana Raja Maha Viharaya. K.D. Lal Kantha Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation
My No.: 4-3/18/2022/WS/56.Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock,Lands and Irrigation,“Mihikatha Medura”, 1200/6,Rajamalwatta Road,Battaramulla,09th April, 2025.
